notes.title: HoloCall 0.1.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
This update mainly adds some customization options to enhance the gameplay experience.
Also, I saw that many players think even the fastest note speed is still too slow… Are you all monsters? (lol)
I’ve adjusted the actual speed corresponding to the setting values, so please find the speed that suits you best again!

0.1.2 Update Details
[list]
[*] Increased actual speed for note speed settings
[*] Option to show or hide track separator lines
[*] Adjustable display position for call-out words
[*] Adjustable display position for the health bar and score bar
[*] Adjustable size for explosion particle effects
[*] Option to show or hide simultaneous note markers
[/list]

Planned Updates
[list]
[*] Display tutorial when no song has been cleared
[*] Allow menu navigation using arrow keys and Enter key
[*] Settings changes will reflect immediately in the preview image
[*] Other minor improvements
[/list]

Thank you all for playing and for your valuable feedback!

notes.title: HoloCall 0.1.1 Update Details
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm Wei. I didn’t expect to receive so much feedback from passionate players so soon after the release!
I’ve made some quick adjustments and also listed the planned changes for the next update.

0.1.1 Update Details:
[list]
[*] "GOOD" judgments no longer reduce HP
[*] The result screen will now wait for the Enter key before proceeding (to make taking screenshots easier)
[*] Made long-hold note colors darker
[/list]

Planned Updates:
[list]
[*] Option to toggle track separation lines
[*] Adjustable explosion effect size
[*] Increased maximum note speed
[*] Customizable display options for call-out text
[*] Tutorial will be shown if no songs have been cleared
[*] Adjustable display options for HP and score bars
[*] Menu navigation with keyboard arrow keys (↑↓) and Enter key
[/list]

Thank you all for playing!
